svg.title: SpaceLab explained in plain language
svg.desc: Ask a question with web search off or on. SpaceLab checks a notebook containing synthetic Malaysian observations plus saved edits. It computes rankings and complete lists itself. If enabled, a web researcher brings back external excerpts. The optional AI writer explains the evidence. Dataset facts and web references stay separate; errors show clear fallback. Users can edit a record, save or cancel, and see saved changes in later answers, maps and downloads.
svg.text: 01 · YOU ASK
Enter a question and choose whether to use the web
Web off: use your dataset only. Web on: look for extra external context.
Example: “What do coastal observations show in southern Malaysia?”
02A · THE NOTEBOOK
Your Malaysian sample observations
103 invented observations across 28 places.
Saved record edits are included automatically.
The measurements are teaching examples.
02B · THE WEB RESEARCHER · OPTIONAL
Find external reference material
Search only when you turn Web search on.
Bring back excerpts and links to their sources.
Keep them separate from your sample values.
03A · THE CALCULATOR & FINDER
Check every matching observation
“Top 5” → sort the measurement values.
“List all” → return all matching observations.
Other questions → search matching source text.
03B · THE EXTRA CONTEXT
Support an external explanation
The writer can use web evidence for context.
Missing web results? Say so and use the dataset.
The web cannot verify invented measurements.
04 · THE WRITER, WHEN NEEDED
AI explains the evidence; calculations stay in Python
The configured model receives the question, dataset evidence and any usable external references.
Computed rankings remain intact; web context can be added underneath.
Offline or failed AI requests show computed results or labelled source excerpts instead.
05 · YOU CHECK
Read the answer, then open References
Dataset records are labelled synthetic. Web references have clickable external links.
Source IDs are kept out of the displayed answer text. Check dates, relevance and limitations.
Download the answer and both reference sets if you want to keep them.
06 · UPDATE THE NOTEBOOK IN DATA EXPLORER
Edit record → change values → Save changes or Cancel
Saved changes update future answers, rankings, map markers and dataset downloads immediately.
The summary and quality label update from your saved measurements and dates.
The Malaysia outline map works offline. Saved edits persist locally across app restarts.
Hosted Heroku editing needs durable storage to keep changes across dyno replacements.
